## Test plan

<!-- How did you verify this? New or updated tests, commands run, platforms covered. -->

---

- [ ] The branch starts with `feature/`, `bugfix/`, `docs/`, `chore/` or `agent/`, the commits are signed off, and the pull request targets `develop`
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has test coverage
- [ ] A user-visible change has a changelog fragment (`changelog.d/<name>.<category>.md`), or the pull request has the `no-changelog` label
- [ ] `clang-format` is clean and the platform-isolation check passes (docs/ci.md)
- [ ] Commit messages and this description carry no attribution lines: no trailers, no tool or vendor names (docs/ci.md, "Commit and pull request text")
